title: Testicular Cancer (germ cell)
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for testicular germ cell tumour. Captures histology, seminoma stage, and NSGCT risk group (IGCCCG) as scenario tags, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Testicular Cancer; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Histology
nodes.title: Histology
nodes.description: Testicular germ cell tumours are divided into seminoma and non-seminomatous germ cell tumour (NSGCT) based on histology; this distinction determines staging workup and treatment pathway.

nodes.name: Seminoma stage
nodes.title: Seminoma stage
nodes.description: Stage I seminoma is confined to the testis with no nodal or distant spread and is typically managed with adjuvant therapy after orchiectomy. Stage II-III seminoma involves retroperitoneal nodal or distant disease and is treated as advanced disease.

nodes.name: NSGCT risk group (IGCCCG)
nodes.title: NSGCT risk group (IGCCCG)
nodes.description: The IGCCCG risk classification stratifies metastatic NSGCT into good, intermediate, and poor risk groups based on primary tumour site, presence of non-pulmonary visceral metastases, and serum tumour marker levels (AFP, hCG, LDH), guiding chemotherapy intensity.

nodes.name: Stage I seminoma: adjuvant carboplatin
nodes.title: Stage I seminoma: adjuvant carboplatin
nodes.description: Stage I seminoma after orchiectomy - adjuvant carboplatin is an option to reduce relapse risk (surveillance and radiotherapy are alternatives). Physician selects.

nodes.name: Advanced seminoma: cisplatin-based chemotherapy
nodes.title: Advanced seminoma: cisplatin-based chemotherapy
nodes.description: Stage II-III (advanced) seminoma - cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy is the systemic treatment backbone. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Good-risk NSGCT: BEP / EP
nodes.title: Good-risk NSGCT: BEP / EP
nodes.description: Good-risk NSGCT by IGCCCG criteria - cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy (BEP or EP) is standard first-line treatment. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Intermediate/poor-risk NSGCT: BEP / VIP
nodes.title: Intermediate/poor-risk NSGCT: BEP / VIP
nodes.description: Intermediate or poor-risk NSGCT by IGCCCG criteria - cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy (BEP or VIP) is standard first-line treatment, with regimen intensity guided by risk group. Physician selects.
